model.raw_definition: MASt3R reciprocal descriptor-NN matches after the locked 3-pixel crop border, linearly triangulated with fixed COLMAP K[R|t], finite homogeneous DLT, and positive depth in both cameras; no reprojection-error ceiling
model.summary_pair_rule: pool footprint-inside points from cross-acquisition-minute-block pairs with fixed-COLMAP camera-centre baseline greater than 0.06 m; preserve every selected pair in run detail

coverage_rule.denominator: EPSG:25832 grid cells whose closed square intersects the supplied footprint
coverage_rule.numerator: eligible denominator cells containing at least one selected footprint-inside DLT point
